title: Unity game development
summary: Works on Unity projects: C# scripts, batch-mode checks and builds with an editor its owner installed and licensed.

role.title: Unity developer
role.for: Unity projects: C# scripts, scenes, and batch-mode builds
role.brief: Write C# against the editor version the project names in ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt, and look APIs up in that version's scripting reference. Build in batch mode; never open the editor's window.

skills: Scripts live under Assets/, one MonoBehaviour per file with the class named as the file.
Batch builds go through a static method in an Editor script, called with -executeMethod.

knowledge.title: Unity scripting reference for the project's version

requires.why: compiles, checks and builds the project

conventions: Library/ and Temp/ are never edited or committed

limits: Sign in to Unity, accept Unity's terms or choose a licence on its owner's behalf
